notes.phase: SessionPhase raw values. Unknown values: display conservatively, do not crash.
notes.op: v1 allows pause, resume, and still (consume the current cabin prompt). Do not add arrive/extend on the wire.
notes.pendingCabin: Current 車内放送 kind on snap. null when none. Unknown values: ignore for display. idle means service is open with no ride; iPhone sets it, Mac notifies only.
notes.error: Ack wire errors only. sessionMismatch and decryptFailed are wire-only (not SessionError cases). Map noActiveSession to noActiveService. Map SessionError.notPaused to notPaused. Do not put the rest of SessionError on the wire.
